acquisition_channels.details: Uses Instagram posts, carousels, and reels; follows current platform trends and responds to inbound comments and inbox messages with personal follow-up.
Boosts organic Instagram posts to a specific zip code.
Describes an email blast to an organization list of about 200, followed by personal one-to-one follow-up; audience consent and status are not stated.

ideas.delivery: Heather's team sources pumpkins from nurseries, distributors, brokers, or farms; stores and sorts inventory; then delivers packages by truck and trailer. Designers arrange porch displays when purchased, and the team can collect pumpkins after the season and take them to a pig farm. Drivers are paid hourly and designers per design.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to customer contact and address data. PECR governs marketing email to individuals and electronic follow-ups; use a valid consent basis or soft opt-in for consumer email marketing. Employment status and payroll duties matter for drivers and designers; Employment Agencies Regulations 2003 may apply if hiring through an agency. No subscription offer is described, so DMCC subscription rules are not implicated.
